source: RFC 4231, section 4, for the first two vectors; tacenta-last-resort-v2-sk-bound is project-authored: HMAC-SHA256 keyed with the 32-byte label of the last-resort replay identity (session-establishment.md, The replay identity) over a 32-byte value, a known answer for the primitive alone. The construction as tacenta-core ships it is exercised by session-establishment/session-e2e.json, vector last-resort-first-message, whose runner requires the recorded replay identity to be this function of the label and the agreed SK

vectors.comment: Key shorter than the block size (the ASCII 'Jefe').
HMAC-SHA256 under the last-resort replay-identity label over the 32 bytes 00 to 1f: the primitive behind the v2 replay identity, which is this function of the label and SK
